title: Benchmark embedded wasm-git backend
description:
Build an experimental Meads Git backend using wazero, WASI Preview 1 filesystem mounts, and a WASI build derived from the sibling wasm-git/libgit2 repository. Keep the native git CLI backend as the baseline and benchmark equivalent local refs/object operations and end-to-end task loads. Network fetch/push is out of scope for the first performance comparison.

Files in scope: the wasm-git experiment worktree only.
